items.rationale: The fixed kitchen unit qualifies as a building component under §4.2.2, with no kitchen-location exclusion. If the surge is confirmed as atmospheric overvoltage under the insured fire group (§2.3.3), §§7.1.9–7.1.10 allow one like-for-like replacement at €1,413 gross.
Under §§7.1.1(b) and 7.1.11, fitting a covered replacement is a repair cost: 1 installation × €480 gross. Any unrelated wiring check must be separated under §9.5 if included in this charge.

A like-for-like console is payable at 1 × €61 gross if the surge damaged the original or replacement was necessary to reinstate the affected unit. The description establishes that a console was present, but not that it was damaged or could not be reused (§§7.1.5, 7.1.7 and 7.1.9).
Freight follows the covered replacement under §7.1.11: 1 consignment × €43 gross. If the shipment also carried unrelated equipment, only the portion attributable to covered replacements is payable.
